description: Professional services: Management Consulting, Strategy Advisory, Digital Transformation, AI Strategy, Cross-Border Consulting
typical_workflows: Client acquisition via network, referrals and LinkedIn
Discovery calls and needs assessment (1-2h per client)
Project delivery: workshops, analysis, coaching sessions
Follow-up: proposal tracking, client relationship management
common_pain_points: Business development consumes productive time: 30-40% for marketing
Proposals take too long: each needs individual customization
Standardization difficult: each client expects tailored solutions
Scaling only with more time: capacity ceiling for solo/small teams
Marketing often neglected: no time for regular content
Knowledge management missing: building each project from scratch
Pricing uncertainty: hourly rates vs. value-based pricing
ai_opportunities: Proposal automation: templates + GPT = 5 instead of 120 minutes
Content marketing: LinkedIn posts, blog articles, newsletters via GPT
Report generation: automated analyses and presentations
Meeting documentation: transcription + summary + action items
Research assistants: client analysis, market research, competitor analysis
Email automation: follow-ups, nurturing sequences, appointment confirmations
CRM automation: lead scoring, activity tracking, pipeline management
Knowledge management: RAG systems for company know-how
typical_tools: Microsoft Office / Google Workspace for documents
Excel / Google Sheets for calculations and lists
Zoom / Microsoft Teams for online meetings

realistic_quick_wins_solo.title: GPT-powered Proposal Generation
realistic_quick_wins_solo.description: Create proposals from templates in 5 instead of 30 minutes. Client data + briefing = GPT generates customized proposal with pricing, deliverables, timeline.
realistic_quick_wins_solo.implementation: Set up templates as prompts, workflow: client data -> GPT -> export

realistic_quick_wins_solo.title: Automated LinkedIn Content Pipeline
realistic_quick_wins_solo.description: Generate weekly expert content via GPT, customize, schedule. Topic list -> GPT -> 3-5 posts per week.
realistic_quick_wins_solo.implementation: Build topic backlog, prompt templates, posting schedule

realistic_quick_wins_solo.title: Automated Meeting Protocols
realistic_quick_wins_solo.description: Zoom/Teams recordings -> automatic transcription -> summary -> action items -> protocol via email.
realistic_quick_wins_solo.implementation: Integration with Zoom/Teams, automatic send after meeting

realistic_quick_wins_solo.title: Email Follow-up Sequences
realistic_quick_wins_solo.description: Automatic follow-up emails after initial call, proposal, project completion. Trigger-based, personalized.
realistic_quick_wins_solo.implementation: Define triggers (e.g., 3 days after proposal), email templates, automation

realistic_quick_wins_solo.title: Research Assistant for Client Analysis
realistic_quick_wins_solo.description: Automatic research on potential clients: LinkedIn profile, company website, recent news -> summary for discovery call.
realistic_quick_wins_solo.implementation: Script for automatic research, template for briefing

realistic_quick_wins_team.title: Central Knowledge Management with RAG
realistic_quick_wins_team.description: All project documents, best practices, templates in a searchable knowledge base. Team finds information in seconds instead of hours.
realistic_quick_wins_team.tool: Notion AI or Custom RAG with Pinecone
realistic_quick_wins_team.implementation: Collect documents, structure, set up RAG

realistic_quick_wins_kmu.title: Enterprise CRM with AI Pipeline Management
realistic_quick_wins_kmu.description: Automatic lead scoring, pipeline forecasts, next-best-actions for sales.
realistic_quick_wins_kmu.implementation: CRM migration, define processes, train team

industry_specific_notes.management_consulting: Focus on strategic analysis, workshops, change management
industry_specific_notes.it_consulting: Technical expertise, system selection, implementation support
industry_specific_notes.digital_transformation: AI strategy, process automation, technology adoption
industry_specific_notes.cross_border: International projects, EU regulations, multi-language support
